_note: Axis-A color round-trip baseline (re-measured 2026-06-03 after the decode-tagging fix attempt). 709-limited is faithful (DirectExport; the resolution default already = bt709/tv). The other three remain KNOWN-FAIL for two distinct reasons the e2e revealed: (1) 601ltd is DirectExport with the source color correctly extracted+threaded to the decoder (decodesOriginal=true, sourceColor={smpte170m}), but the export is unchanged (~22) -> WebView2's VideoDecoder IGNORES VideoDecoderConfig.colorSpace, so feeding it the right matrix has no effect (the spec's Approach A is necessary-but-insufficient; a per-frame colorSpace relabel is needed). (2) 709full/601full route through a PROXY (export_uses_original=false, proxy_path set) -> the original-decode-only fix doesn't touch them; proxy color is a separate slice. For known-bad encodings expectFaithful=false asserts the bug is still present; flip to true when the deeper fix lands.

709full.known_cause: routes to proxy (full-range); proxy color out of scope

601full.known_cause: routes to proxy (full-range); proxy color out of scope
